pr_body:
Closes #62

## Summary

Adds a manual-only workflow that runs the closest available public-data reconstruction of the AGENTICAITA paper window.

## Changes

- Adds a `Paper Window Real Data Replication` workflow with manual dispatch inputs.
- Supports `closest` mode, which attempts Hyperliquid first and falls back to Binance USD-M when Hyperliquid cannot produce complete exportable OHLCV coverage.
- Runs the real-data replication workflow, quality checks, run manifests, result index, HTML dashboard, GitHub Actions summary, and compact artefact upload.
- Avoids raw SQLite and per-symbol raw OHLCV CSV uploads by default.
- Documents the workflow and interpretation limits.

## Validation

- `git apply --check /tmp/issue62v2.diff` in a clean temporary git worktree.
- Static review of workflow steps against existing scripts.
- Full live market-data workflow was not run from this patch submission because it is a manual workflow and may take a long time or hit public exchange rate limits.
